verdict.rationale: Productboard's docs explicitly state you can 'reschedule an initiative' and 'move an initiative to a new release' via its MCP server/agent integration, directly matching the story. This is vendor-documented but lacks independent hands-on corroboration or detail on native UI drag-and-drop rescheduling workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification, native roadmap UI documentation for manual rescheduling beyond API/agent access.
